meta.title: Cathodic Arc Plasma Source
meta.description: Starthermatech provides XHS-CAIS cathodic arc ion source complete equipment using solid metal targets to produce high-flux metal ion beams. Suitable for thin film deposition, surface modification, and research beam experiments. Provides cooling systems, target replacement, and flange customization services. Compatible with Faraday/RPA/Langmuir probe diagnostics, supporting equipment procurement and technical support.
page.title: Cathodic Arc Plasma Source (XHS‑CAIS)
page.lead: Solid metal propellant, high ionization and high-flux metal beams for coatings and surface engineering.
detail.title: Cathodic Arc Source XHS‑CAIS
detail.tagline: High-flux metal ion beams with interchangeable targets
detail.overview: Evaporates and ionizes metal cathodes to produce high-flux metal ion beams for thin films, surface modification, and research platforms. Compact design, replaceable targets, cooling options, and tunable process parameters.
detail.feature2: High-flux metal ion beam for deposition/surface work
detail.feature3: Modular target swap and cooling for long runs
detail.feature4: Pairs with Faraday/RPA/LP for beam diagnostics
